newsitem.title: USA: Toll Brothers Q1 signed contracts rise.
newsitem.headline: Toll Brothers Q1 signed contracts rise.

text.p: Toll Brothers Inc said on Wednesday that for the first quarter ended January 31, 1997, signed contracts totaled about $173 million (442 homes), a 17 percent increase over the previous first quarter record of $147.9 million (414 homes).
The company's backlog of about $498 million (1,259 homes) at quarter-end surpassed by 22 percent the previous first quarter of $407.3 million (1,101 homes).
Toll Brothers designs, builds and arranges financing for luxury single family homes.
